name: Boxer's Fracture / Fifth Metacarpal Neck Fracture
tags: boxer's fracture / fifth metacarpal neck fracture
definition: Fracture of the fifth metacarpal neck, commonly caused by punching a hard object.

investigations.principle: Hand radiographs establish angulation and fracture pattern.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Rotational deformity, open injury or unacceptable alignment requires reduction/surgical assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Hasta-bhagna principles may complement healing after alignment assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the fifth metacarpal neck, commonly caused by punching a hard object.
